FULL TEXT:
ONGC Tripura Power Company Limited (OTPC)
Revised Job Description
Position Medical Officer - One Position
(On Contractual Basis – on the payroll of third party, initially for one year)
Place of Posting Palatana, Tripura
Qualification MBBS
Experience Minimum 1 Year of post-qualification experience in the relevant area.
(Recently superannuated candidates may also apply)
Maximum Age
Limit NA
Industry Type Power Sector
Compensation Rs.70,000/- to Rs.1,00,000/- Per Month
Job Description
• Shall be responsible for running of Medical Centre.
• Managing occupational Health of employees on rolls of the Company and
Contractors.
• Meeting Statutory compliance and keeping records pertaining to Medical
Centre
• Maintaining statutory compliance for the Medical Centre as per
applicable rules (CTO of medical Centre, Bio-medical waste rules etc.)
• Act as auditee for all such audits of Medical Centre to be conducted by
OTPC as well as by third party.
• Ensuring periodic health check-ups of all workers inside the plant.
• Planning, development & budget monitoring including manpower
planning of the Medical Centre
• The repository of the information pertaining to the Occupational Health
Centre.
• Help and support in CSR activities as and when required.
• Liasioning with government hospitals and health authorities.
• Maintaining strict office decorum.
• Ensure to keep up to date inventory and stock register with its proper
accounting and responsible to initiate the fresh requisition of the inventory.
• Health talk and training of entire staff working for the organization.
• To ensure proper maintenance of the Ambulance.
• Should be responsible for screening all such cases needing specialized
medical attention and refer them to the higher centre for further
treatment.
• Any other responsibility assigned by the Company from time to time.Desired
Profile
• Excellent communication and personality is a must
• Candidates with 01 year of experience in managing hospital and AFIH
(Associate Fellowship in Industrial Health) shall be preferred
• Local candidate from Tripura shall be preferred
• The Position is on contract basis, initially for one year and may be
extended further subject to performance and mutual consent
